subject: alice-meadows
detail:
She is filed CIVILIAN — no flight, no Jonah ID — and that is correct. It is also not the same thing as unharmed. Viraena, on 7 September: SHE DIDN'T GET OUT OF HELL, SHE HAD HER OWN.

The Archive holds nothing about it. Not a place, not a duration, not who did it. It knows she is the Older Sister, the Chaos Guardian, Knife-in-Heels; it knows she punched Bryn repeatedly in a doorway and then carried Torie away from her; it knows she was in the first arc and that she is twenty-eight and has been for four years. It does not know what happened before any of that.

HELD OPEN DELIBERATELY. The Archive has already invented one origin for this woman today and will not be inventing a second.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. Her hell was not being able to protect Torie — in high school, and then through the therapy years after. See c-alice-hell-named. RETIRED.
